english.title: Permit the use of a vehicle fitted with blue warning light etc
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on a road, **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), fitted with a

(A)_[blue warning beacon.]_
(B)_[special warning lamp.]_
(C)_[device resembling a blue warning beacon.]_
(D)_[device resembling a special warning lamp.]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 16 of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
permitted use on a road of a vehicle fitted with
blue warning beacon or
special warning lamp or
device resembling a blue warning beacon or

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 16 does not apply to emergency vehicles.
(ii) Regulation 16 applies whether the beacon is in working order or not.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iv) See also associated offence wordings H2600 and H2601.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale (level four if goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers).

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
